integrity.external_results: The word/sequence identification is explicitly credited; the classical i.i.d. central limit theorem and Slutsky lemma are standard.
integrity.finite_checks: The included script independently checks direct hiccup indicators against tree words and verifies exact small-tree prefix bounds.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact finite-word identities and analytic coupling to independent uniform child digits; no stochastic limit is inferred from finite samples.

scientific_limitations: Weak convergence for a uniformly sampled integer index, with k and x fixed; no pointwise or functional Gaussian limit is claimed.
No quantitative convergence rate or uniformity in varying parameters is established.
The complement-word identification comes from Cloitre, arXiv:2610.13908v1, Proposition 4.3.
Unindexed work under an alternative formulation remains a possible literature-overlap risk.
title: Gaussian fluctuations of generalized hiccup complements
